record.scopeText: The kernel rechecked 63,290 declarations in the full logical dependency closure of the lettered main results, starting from an empty Lean environment.
record.limits: The replay reused the compiled objects identified by the project’s source and object hashes. It covers the displayed proofs and their mathematical dependencies.

artifacts.label: Project source and compiled proof hashes

record.correspondence: Lean proves that the square of the original homogeneous function is the diagonal of a positive Hermitian form, over both the complex and quaternionic fields. The proof uses the vanishing of the rational homology class of the clutching map.

link.label: Complex case
